'''XD-M8 Remote Mine''' was a type of explosive used by the [[Eternal Empire]] of [[Zakuul]]. During the [[Invasion of Voss]] in [[3630 BBY]], several such mines were used by Zakuulan forces in their attack on [[Voss-Ka]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
XD-M8 Remote Mines appear in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' during '''"Chapter I: Wrath and Ruin"'''.

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' {{1st}}
